# Captured from gno 1.29.6 by scripts/capture-gno-contract.sh.
# Verbatim upstream --help output. Do not hand-edit.

=== gno --help ===
Usage: gno [options] [command]

GNO - Local Knowledge Index and Retrieval

Options:
  -V, --version                   show version
  --index <name>                  index name (default: "default")
  --config <path>                 config file path
  --no-color                      disable colors
  --verbose                       verbose logging
  --yes                           non-interactive mode
  -q, --quiet                     suppress non-essential output
  --json                          JSON output (for errors and supported
                                  commands)
  --offline                       offline mode (use cached models only)
  --no-pager                      disable automatic paging of long output
  -h, --help                      display help for command

Commands:
  search [options] <query>        BM25 keyword search
  vsearch [options] <query>       Vector similarity search
  query [options] <query...>      Hybrid search with expansion and reranking
  bench [options] <fixture>       Run retrieval quality benchmarks from a
                                  fixture
  ask [options] <query>           Human-friendly query with grounded answer
  profile                         Inspect a project-local retrieval profile
  init [options] [path]           Initialize GNO configuration
  setup [options] <folder>        Add and verify a folder with a real lexical
                                  retrieval
  index [options] [collection]    Index files from collections
  status [options]                Show index status
  doctor [options]                Diagnose configuration issues
  capture [options] [content...]  Capture a note with provenance
  collection                      Manage collections
  egress-audit                    Manage local content-free egress audit
                                  receipts
  context                         Manage context items
  models                          Manage LLM models
  update [options]                Sync files from disk into the index
  embed [options] [collection]    Generate embeddings for indexed documents
  cleanup                         Clean orphaned data from index
  reset [options]                 Delete all GNO data and start fresh
  trace                           Inspect and manage private local retrieval
                                  traces
  publish                         Export publish artifacts for gno.sh
  vec                             Vector index maintenance
  get [options] <ref>             Get document by URI or docid
  multi-get [options] <refs...>   Get multiple documents by URI or docid
  ls [options] [scope]            List indexed documents
  tags                            Manage document tags
  links                           Document link commands
  backlinks [options] <doc>       List documents linking to this document
  similar [options] <doc>         Find semantically similar documents
  graph [options]                 Output knowledge graph of document links
  changes [options]               List retained metadata-only document changes
  diff [options] <doc>            Show one retained metadata-only structural
                                  change
  impact [options] <doc>          Find bounded inbound knowledge dependencies
  mcp                             MCP server and configuration
  skill                           Manage GNO agent skill
  daemon [options]                Start headless continuous indexing
  serve [options]                 Start web UI server
  completion                      Shell completion scripts
  help [command]                  display help for command

Documentation: https://github.com/gmickel/gno#readme
Report issues: https://github.com/gmickel/gno/issues

=== gno setup --help ===
Usage: gno setup [options] <folder>

Add and verify a folder with a real lexical retrieval

Options:
  -n, --name <name>        collection name
  --exclude <pattern>      literal exclusion pattern (repeatable) (default: [])
  --authorize-secret-risk  explicitly authorize indexing likely secret files
  --connector <id>         install and verify one connector (repeatable)
                           (default: [])
  --apply-profile          apply a valid project profile before lexical setup
  --no-semantic            skip background semantic indexing
  --json                   JSON output
  -h, --help               display help for command

=== gno search --help ===
Usage: gno search [options] <query>

BM25 keyword search

Options:
  -n, --limit <num>        max results
  --min-score <num>        minimum score threshold
  -c, --collection <name>  filter by collection
  --lang <code>            language filter/hint (BCP-47)
  --since <date>           modified-at lower bound (ISO date/time or token)
  --until <date>           modified-at upper bound (ISO date/time or token)
  --category <values>      require category match (comma-separated)
  --author <text>          filter by author (case-insensitive contains)
  --intent <text>          disambiguating context for ambiguous queries
  --exclude <values>       exclude docs containing any term (comma-separated)
  --tags-all <tags>        require ALL tags (comma-separated)
  --tags-any <tags>        require ANY tag (comma-separated)
  --project-root <path>    trusted project root (repeatable; replaces cwd
                           affinity) (default: [])
  --no-project-affinity    disable project-aware ranking
  --full                   include full content
  --line-numbers           include line numbers in output
  --json                   JSON output
  --md                     Markdown output
  --csv                    CSV output
  --xml                    XML output
  --files                  file paths only
  -h, --help               display help for command

=== gno status --help ===

Show index status

Options:
  --json      JSON output
  -h, --help  display help for command

=== gno doctor --help ===
Usage: gno doctor [options]

Diagnose configuration issues

Options:
  --json      JSON output
  -h, --help  display help for command

=== gno index --help ===
Usage: gno index [options] [collection]

Index files from collections

Options:
  --no-embed     skip embedding after sync
  --git-pull     run git pull in git repositories
  --models-pull  download models if missing
  --json         JSON output
  -h, --help     display help for command

=== gno update --help ===
Usage: gno update [options]

Sync files from disk into the index

Options:
  --git-pull  run git pull in git repositories
  --json      JSON output
  -h, --help  display help for command

=== gno reset --help ===
Usage: gno reset [options]

Delete all GNO data and start fresh

Options:
  --confirm      confirm destructive operation
  --keep-config  preserve config file
  --keep-cache   preserve model cache
  -h, --help     display help for command

=== gno daemon --help ===
Usage: gno daemon [options]

Start headless continuous indexing

Options:
  -p, --port <num>               MCP gateway port (default: "3000")
  --no-sync-on-start             skip initial sync and only watch future file
                                 changes
  --json                         JSON output (applies to --status; see
                                 process-status schema)
  --host <address>               HTTP listen address (default: 127.0.0.1)
  --mcp-token-file <path>        restrictive bearer token file
  --mcp-allowed-host <host>      exact allowed Host header (repeatable)
  --mcp-allowed-origin <origin>  exact allowed Origin (repeatable)
  --mcp-enable-write             authorize HTTP MCP mutation tools (independent
                                 of authentication)
  --detach                       run as a detached background process
                                 (macOS/Linux only)
  --status                       show status of the detached daemon process (use
                                 --json for machine output)
  --stop                         stop the detached daemon process (SIGTERM then
                                 SIGKILL fallback)
  --pid-file <path>              override pid-file path
  --log-file <path>              override log-file path (append-only)
  -h, --help                     display help for command

=== gno serve --help ===
Usage: gno serve [options]

Start web UI server

Options:
  -p, --port <num>               port to listen on (default: "3000")
  --json                         JSON output (applies to --status; see
                                 process-status schema)
  --host <address>               loopback HTTP listen address (default:
                                 127.0.0.1)
  --mcp-token-file <path>        restrictive bearer token file
  --mcp-allowed-host <host>      exact allowed Host header (repeatable)
  --mcp-allowed-origin <origin>  exact allowed Origin (repeatable)
  --mcp-enable-write             authorize HTTP MCP mutation tools (independent
                                 of authentication)
  --detach                       run as a detached background process
                                 (macOS/Linux only)
  --status                       show status of the detached serve process (use
                                 --json for machine output)
  --stop                         stop the detached serve process (SIGTERM then
                                 SIGKILL fallback)
  --pid-file <path>              override pid-file path
  --log-file <path>              override log-file path (append-only)
  -h, --help                     display help for command

=== gno mcp --help ===
Usage: gno mcp [options] [command]

MCP server and configuration

Options:
  -h, --help           display help for command

Commands:
  serve [options]      Start MCP server (stdio transport)
  install [options]    Install gno as MCP server in client configuration
  uninstall [options]  Remove gno MCP server from client configuration
  status [options]     Show MCP server installation status
  help [command]       display help for command

=== gno collection --help ===
Usage: gno collection [options] [command]

Manage collections

Options:
  -h, --help                         display help for command

Commands:
  add [options] <path>               Add a collection
  list [options]                     List collections
  remove <name>                      Remove a collection
  rename <old> <new>                 Rename a collection
  clear-embeddings [options] <name>  Clear stale or all embeddings for a
                                     collection
  policy                             Inspect and change collection egress policy
  help [command]                     display help for command

=== gno mcp install -t claude-code -s user --dry-run --json ===
{
  "installed": {
    "target": "claude-code",
    "scope": "user",
    "configPath": "<home>/.claude.json",
    "action": "dry_run_create",
    "serverEntry": {
      "command": "<home>/.bun/bin/bun",
      "args": [
        "run",
        "<home>/.bun/install/global/node_modules/@gmickel/gno/src/index.ts",
        "--index",
        "default",
        "--config",
        "<gno-dirs>/config/index.yml",
        "mcp"
      ],
      "env": {
        "GNO_DATA_DIR": "<gno-dirs>/data",
        "GNO_CACHE_DIR": "<gno-dirs>/cache"
      }
    }
  }
}
